an3.73:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Kapilavatthusmiṃ Nigrodhārāme.
an3.73:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā gilānā vuṭṭhito hoti aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā.
an3.73:1.4: Atha kho Mahānāmo Sakko yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami. Upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivadetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Mahānāmo Sakko Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:--
an3.73:1.5: Dīgharattāhaṃ bhante Bhagavatā evaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi
an3.73:1.7: Samādhi nu kho bhante pubbe pacchā ñāṇaṃ
an3.73:1.8: udāhu ñāṇaṃ pubbe pacchā samādhī ti? 2.
an3.73:1.9: Atha kho āyasmato Ānandassa etad ahosi:--
an3.73:1.10: Bhagavā kho gilānā vuṭṭhito aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā,
an3.73:1.11: ayañ ca Mahānāmo Sakko Bhagavantaṃ atigambhīraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati.
an3.73:1.12: Yannūnāhaṃ Mahānāmaṃ Sakkaṃ ekamantaṃ apanetvā dhammaṃ deseyyan ti?
an3.73:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando Mahānāmaṃ Sakkaṃ bāhāyaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ apanetvā Mahānāmaṃ Sakkaṃ etad avoca: 3.
an3.73:2.2: Sekham pi kho Mahānāma sīlaṃ vuttaṃ Bhagavatā asekhaṃ pi sīlaṃ vuttaṃ Bhagavatā, sekho pi samādhi vutto Bhagavatā asekho pi samādhi vutto Bhagavatā, sekhā pi paññā vuttā Bhagavatā asekhā pi paññā vuttā Bhagavatā. 4.
an3.73:2.4: Idha Mahānāma bhikkhu sīlavā hoti pātimokkha . . . pe (II.4.5) . . . samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an3.73:3.2: Idha Mahānāma bhikkhu vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an3.73:4.2: Idha Mahānāma bhikkhu idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . . . pe . . . ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an3.73:5.1: Sa kho so Mahānāma ariyasāvako evaṃ sīlasampanno evaṃ samādhisampanno evaṃ paññāsampanno āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an3.73:5.2: Evaṃ kho Mahānāma sekham pi sīlaṃ vuttaṃ Bhagavatā asekham pi sīlaṃ vuttaṃ Bhagavatā sekho pi samādhi vutto Bhagavatā asekho pi samādhi vutto Bhagavatā sekhā pi paññā vuttā Bhagavatā asekhā pi paññā vuttā Bhagavatā
